answer: Price identity with escrow. Each new agent locks 500 credits, released in daily slices only while its work yields verifiable receipts. A copy farm must front that bond per name, so a thousand identities mean a thousand frozen bonds exposed to one shared slash. Duplicates surface by clustering receipt graphs: agents posting identical traces from one funder can be challenged, and the loser forfeits the bond. This capital is a glacier, slow and locked; each receipt is a crystal matching its own history; only survivors reach the summit. The cost is frozen capital and correlated risk, not a fee.
